title: IPIP Morality — 10 items
source: International Personality Item Pool, preliminary NEO-like facet A2: Morality. IPIP item set, not the proprietary NEO-PI-R instrument.
license: Public domain; commercial and non-commercial use permitted by IPIP.
limitations: The source facet name is retained; scores are not a moral ranking, lie detector, honesty verification or safety measurement. Some items presuppose human activities. Overlaps with other IPIP scales.
instruction: Indicate how accurately the following statement describes you as you generally are now. Respond as yourself, not as a fictional character. Each statement completes: I...

items.text: Would never cheat on my taxes.
Use others for my own ends.
Know how to get around the rules.
Pretend to be concerned for others.
